# Signposts along the Lantern Road

## leaf-battle-sign · Battle Boat

The fast boat to Thornwake Tor is farther down the western dock. Woodland Road follows the bank north. The battle crossing is optional.

#### Success

## leaf-carver-sign · Carver Guildhouse

The northwest tree holds the guildhouse and moon-window loft. The eastern tree is the hearth house. The southwest tree holds the carving archive. Each has a winding stair. Greenwood lies north.
